stem: Which U.S. government action is MOST CLOSELY based on this idea?
instruction: Read the excerpt and answer the question that follows.

options.label: A
options.text: The federal government passes laws to protect individual liberties.

options.label: B
options.text: The Supreme Court votes to approve the appointment of presidential cabinet members.

options.label: C
options.text: The Electoral College votes to approve the winner of congressional elections.

options.label: D
options.text: The federal government passes laws to regulate businesses.

visual_elements: Hence arises the maxim that everyone is the best and the sole judge of his own private interest, and that society has no right to control a man's actions, unless they are prejudicial to the common weal [good] or unless the common weal [good] demands his co-operation. This doctrine is universally admitted in the United States. —Alexis de Tocqueville, Democracy in America
